The content of this update is as follows:

optimization:
Modify the gold coin income in a single game

BUG:
BUG in English language skill description;

How to play:
1. Added endless mode, unlimited challenge;
2. Added a creative workshop to choose your favorite MOD through the community;


How to get the MOD toolbox:
Mail: 211206417@qq.com
Enter "MOD" to receive the MOD production toolbox

notes.title: Add the game to your wishlist and you will be notified as
notes.content:
Hello fellow brave men!

It’s a bit abrupt to meet you all in this way (laughter), but we are very much looking forward to seeing you with this product! Although this is our first time trying to release a meat pigeon game, I can assure you with all my heart that it is really fun to play chicken! (vomited blood)

At present, there are only two simple maps, and other maps are still under development, but we have put a 10-meter-long sword on the neck of the technology, forcing the technology to complete it as soon as possible, and we will definitely be open to creativity in the next few months. Workshop function! ! (Writing code non-stop)

For this reason, please be patient and wait, the thrilling and exciting things are yet to come~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44728874/95cff8f347df09d444552d75952fea6a19df4378.png[/img]

So when the time comes, please use your little brains to your heart’s content!
